newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria parent expects good 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria parent expects good 1997 earnings.

text.p: Bank Austria, the country's top banking group, said on Thursday it expected a "satisfactory earnings development" for its core parent bank.
The bank traced the improvement to an "easing of credit, the risk situation and internal cost cutting measures".
Last week, the bank reported a 29 percent increase in first-quarter parent operating profit to 1.395 billion schillings.

In a statement released ahead of its annual news conference on Thursday, the bank warned that last week's figures could not simply be multiplied by four to reach either full year group or parent earnings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
